events.title: Free First Bucket for New Visitors
events.desc: First-time visitors get a free range bucket ($12 value), valid for 7 days after claiming. New customers also get a free hotdog and soda with a bucket purchase. The offer runs through Oct 30, 2026.

events.title: Trinity Forest Invitational (SMU Men's Golf)
events.desc: SMU's home fall college event at Trinity Forest, the Coore & Crenshaw links-style course that used to host the Byron Nelson.

events.title: 2026 CREW Dallas Golf Classic
events.desc: CREW Dallas, a commercial real estate group, holds its annual golf classic at PGA Frisco.

events.title: 47th Annual Grapevine Chamber Golf Tournament
events.desc: Two four-person scrambles on the same day, hosted by the Grapevine Chamber. A foursome costs $800 for one tournament or $1,600 for both, and an individual costs $200. Green fees, cart, meals and prizes are included.

events.title: Carter's Classic Charity Golf Tournament
events.venue: The Clubs of Prestonwood — The Creek
events.desc: Charity tournament founded in memory of Carter Campisi. It provides hospitals with Caring Cradles and supports pregnancy and infant-loss education and awareness.

events.title: PGA of America Women's Golf Clinic – Lantana
events.desc: This is one of the PGA of America's national women's clinics, with PGA coaches teaching at about an 8:1 student-to-coach ratio. An individual registration is $1,000, and sponsored spots may be available.

events.title: Malbon Buckets Cup - Maridoe
events.desc: Stroke-play stop with a $36,000 purse, open to qualified pros and top amateurs, at $750 per player. Winners advance to the Buckets Cup finale at Pinehurst No. 4, and registration closes Oct 2.

events.title: New Green Fee Rates Take Effect
events.desc: Grapevine GC starts new green fee rates on October 8. The course also became a 27-hole facility on September 24.

events.title: 13th Annual Maggie Thompson Invitational
events.desc: Four-person scramble at $125 per player, with a taco buffet, two mulligans and a $5,000 hole-in-one prize. Proceeds go mainly to the Amity Hospice Thanksgiving Dinner Drive.

events.title: 2026 DBIA-SW DFW Golf Tournament
events.desc: Foursome tournament for the architecture, engineering and construction industry at $1,700 per team. It includes closest-to-pin, long drive, beat-the-pro and best-dressed contests, and benefits the DBIA Southwest scholarship program.

events.title: The Knights Classic Golf Tournament
events.desc: Omega Delta Phi Alumni Association of Dallas–Fort Worth tournament raising funds for student scholarships.

events.title: Fall Market at PGA Frisco
events.desc: Outdoor market with more than 50 vendors selling artisan goods, fashion, jewelry, candles and fall decor.

events.title: Little Designers: Fall Market Pumpkin Decorating
events.desc: Kids decorate pumpkins during the Fall Market. Tickets are sold separately on Eventbrite.

events.title: Tour Edge Fitting Day
events.desc: Tour Edge club fitting session at the Leonard Golf Links range. You book a slot online through uSchedule.

events.title: TheGrint Tour NTX: Torbay Cup
events.desc: Amateur tour event in TheGrint Tour's North Texas 2026 schedule.

events.title: 2026 DAMC Golf Classic
events.desc: Two-player scramble at $200 per golfer or $375 per team. It funds Dallas A&M Club scholarships for local seniors going to Texas A&M.

events.title: Bill Carollo "Back The Blue" Golf Tournament

events.title: Golf Classic 2026 — Recovery Resource Council
events.desc: Recovery Resource Council's 37th annual Golf Classic, a 4-person scramble raising funds for wellness and recovery services. $250 per person.

events.title: Fairways to Foster Jubilee Invitational
events.desc: Foursome charity invitational celebrating Foster College's centennial year, raising money for the college.

events.title: SUAF-Dallas Chapter 16th Annual Founders' Golf Tournament

events.title: XXIO Club Fitting Day

events.title: 80s Mix Tape Band Concert
events.desc: Free outdoor concert by an 80s cover band; no tickets needed. Bring a blanket; lawn chairs and outside food are not allowed.

events.title: Spooktacular Scramble

events.title: Trunk or Treat
events.desc: A Halloween trunk-or-treat social event listed on the Bridlewood club calendar.

events.title: 2026 Transportation Club of DFW Annual Golf Tournament
events.desc: 18-hole transportation-industry tournament with a putting contest, lunch, dinner, raffle and awards. It benefits the Transportation Club of DFW.

events.desc: Players golf alongside former MLB players, followed by dinner, an auction and awards. It benefits the MLB Players Alumni Association.

events.desc: Free 1-hour simulator session with sign-up, 50% off TrackMan session packs ($99.99-$299.99 value), and a closest-to-the-pin challenge for prizes. The store pages list 'October 22' without a year.

events.title: 15th Annual Charity Golf Tournament — The Nodding Donkey

events.title: 2026 Gleneagles Charity Classic Golf Tournament

events.title: Second Annual nonPareil Plano Golf Classic

Entry is $250, which covers cart, day-one lunch and prizes. Entries close Oct 17 at 5 PM through the Rockwood pro shop.

events.title: Halloween Par-Tee
events.desc: PGA Frisco's yearly Halloween party in The District.

events.title: Titleist Fitting Day

events.title: 2026 DFW Airport United Way Golf Tournament
events.desc: A United Way charity tournament run by the DFW Airport community. The listing estimates about $125 per player, and registration is through BirdEase.

events.desc: Annual fundraiser for the Diamond Hill-Jarvis Heritage Foundation, which supports educational opportunities for Diamond Hill-Jarvis High School students.

events.title: 2026 Trick or Treat Scramble

events.title: 10th Levy Cup Matches (Northern Texas PGA)

Proceeds support Genesis Women's Shelter & Support, The Warren Center and In-Sync Exotics. $250 per golfer or $750 per foursome; registration and breakfast from 7:30 AM, 9:00 AM shotgun.

events.title: Glow Fore It! Family Glow Golf Night (First Tee – Fort Worth)

events.desc: First Tee – Fort Worth's family glow golf fundraiser on the River's Edge par-3 course. The 2025 edition also had a glow putting course, an outdoor movie, music and games.

events.title: PING Fitting Day

events.title: Veterans Day Supercars Show

events.title: Veterans Day Weekend at PGA Frisco
events.desc: All-day Veterans Day celebration in The PGA District.

events.desc: Annual Superintendent's Revenge: a 2-person, 9-hole scramble on a tricked-up course setup. $50 public / $25 members and residents, including golf, cart and prizes, with an optional raffle. Register in the pro shop or call/text 940-209-5374.

events.title: TPGC Holiday Scramble

Adult volunteers pay $250 (3–4 shifts); student volunteers ages 16–22 are free.
